title: Kar ve İnci
author: Nihan Kaya
description: On the longest night of the year, renowned composer Deniz İlter hosts a grand event. Gece, a mysterious woman in a simple black dress, moves through the hall as if unseen. Watching from afar, Deniz’s son Kaya recalls their past: a passionate love that ended abruptly when Gece vanished from his life and the orchestra. Years later, they meet again as musicians—violin and cello playing together. Can two separate voices merge into harmony? Snow and Pearl is a delicate exploration of love, desire, and the complex interplay of separation and connection, told through music, symbolism, and longing.
